minutes.summary: The Select Board, joined by the Facilities Director and members of the Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, conducted an on-site walking tour of Brooks House and the former TCP school building to observe their physical condition ahead of any future public deliberation on the properties. The tour covered ADA access, structural, electrical, HVAC/boiler, roofing, asbestos and mold issues at both buildings, plus the food pantry's and town departments' current use of TCP space; no substantive votes were taken, and the meeting ended with a vote to adjourn.
minutes.headline: Select Board and design committee toured Brooks House and TCP in person to assess building condition ahead of a future decision on the properties.

what_happened.line: Select Board members, the facilities director, and the town's building design committee toured Brooks House and the former TCP school in person to assess condition.
A food pantry representative questioned whether Brooks House can hold the pantry, citing water, bathroom, and floor-load needs, with no alternative site ready by October 1st.
The tour covered TCP's boiler leaks, asbestos-related ceiling costs, and ADA-trigger cost thresholds on roof work, with several cost figures described as estimates still to be confirmed.
A board member asked what basis existed for a roof-cost figure presented at a 2023 special town meeting; the facilities director said no formal roofer estimate existed at that time.
No votes were taken on the properties; the meeting ended with a vote to adjourn.

why_it_matters: Any eventual decision on Brooks House or TCP — including where the food pantry operates — will carry repair, ADA-compliance, and asbestos-abatement costs that a future town meeting may be asked to fund.
Whether roof or renovation work crosses an ADA-trigger cost threshold changes the scope and cost of any project at TCP, which affects what gets proposed to voters.
The pantry's relocation options remain unresolved, which matters to anyone who relies on that service or lives near either building.
